flags.why: Here, bịch means a woven bamboo grain container, not a sack ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/b%E1%BB%8Bch)).
flags.fix: The storeroom is piled full of woven baskets and bins for storing rice.

flags.why: Thị chính means municipal administration, while the building called city hall is tòa thị chính ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/th%E1%BB%8B_ch%C3%ADnh)).
The meaning 'wave' is local to Phú Lộc in Huế and needs a Central region tag ([dictionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/m%C3%B2i)).
